articles.title: Voter Guide Meet the Judicial Candidates on the Nov Ballot
articles.excerpt: Kristen Hawkins has been a Harris County district court judge since 2016 and has a background in civil litigation (San Antonio Report).

articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: Kristen Hawkins won the race for Texas Supreme Court, Place 7 with 5,112,073 votes (52.8%); opponent: Kyle Hawkins (R) 4,572,758 (47.2%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
